auth.unsupportedReason: This browser does not expose WebAuthn. Use a recent Chrome, Safari, Firefox, or Edge on a device with a built-in authenticator.

loading.title: Loading…
loading.blurb: Looking for an existing vault on this device.

fresh.title: Your notes, locked to a passkey.
fresh.blurb: Everything stays on this device. The only way in is the passkey you create — no email, no password, no recovery codes.
fresh.foot: Lose every device with this passkey and the vault is unrecoverable — by design.

locked.title: Welcome back.
locked.blurb: Tap to unlock with the passkey you enrolled on this device.

busy.blurb: Follow the prompt from your authenticator. This may take a few seconds.

empty.title: No notes yet.
empty.blurb: Tap “New note” to write your first one. Everything stays on this device.

editor.bodyPlaceholder: Write something only you can read.

receive.title: Receive a note
receive.minting: Setting up a one-shot pickup window…
receive.readAloud: Read this code to the sender. They have five minutes.
receive.waiting: Waiting for the sender to upload the note.
receive.received: Got it. The note has been added to your vault.

send.title: Send this note
send.askCode: Type the code the recipient shows you. Letters and dashes are both fine.
send.sent: Sent. The recipient is decrypting it now.

error.network: Couldn't reach the share backend. Check your connection and try again.
error.rendezvousNotFound: No rendezvous with that code. Re-check the letters and digits.
error.rendezvousExpired: That code has expired. Ask the recipient to start a new pickup window.
error.commitmentMismatch: The backend returned a public key that doesn't match the code. Aborting for safety.
error.blobAlreadyUploaded: A note has already been uploaded to that code. Ask for a fresh pickup window.
error.blobUnavailable: The shared note has already been picked up.
error.rateLimited: Too many share attempts from this device. Wait a few minutes.
error.originDenied: The share backend isn't accepting requests from this origin.
error.protocol: Unexpected response from the share backend.
